---
# Managed by gitmoji init --provisional-workflow
applyTo: "**"
---

Use the repository's normal review standard by default. A 🚧 provisional or 🧪 exploratory pull request identifies work intended for a demo or comparison. Use its verified Gitmoji follow-up and the stated demo scope to decide which findings may wait. When the scope or verification is unclear, use the normal review standard.

Report build, type and test failures, security and secret exposure, data integrity, incorrect permissions, and failures a participant can encounter in the demo. Check accessibility requirements needed to complete the demo and any existing product or legal requirements. Apply normal review to settled changes in a mixed pull request.

Collect remaining deferred qualities such as unfinished styling, motion and final copy into one summary with examples and the follow-up issue. A maintainer chooses which threads to transfer. Before resolving a deferred thread, record its finding and source on the follow-up and reply with the issue number.
